//: SPA fallback. This app uses client-side routing, so a hard refresh on a
deep link like /users/abc asks Vercel for a file that does not exist and
would 404. Rewriting every non-asset path to index.html hands routing
back to React Router. Rewrite, not redirect - the URL must stay intact
for the router to read it.
Vercel serves real files in /assets before applying this, so hashed JS

headers.//: Asset filenames are content-hashed by Vite, so they can be cached forever.
The app is not meant to be framed; this blocks clickjacking.
